gotchas: Covers three of the seven Quebec retail listings: '60A MPPT (max PV 160V, 2880W)' (= POW-M60-PRO or POW-M60-MAX, both 160 Vdc max PV), '20A MPPT 12V/24V auto' (= POW-KEEPER 1220) and '40A MPPT 12V/24V auto' (= POW-KEEPER 1240).

Retail wattage contradicts the vendor manual. Every PowMr 60 A manual states 2800 W at 48 V (720 W/12 V, 1440 W/24 V, 2100 W/36 V); the retailer's 2880 W appears nowhere in PowMr documentation and is exactly 60 A x 48 V, i.e. arithmetic rather than a spec. Recorded, not resolved.
The KEEPER's two USB ports are 5 V/1 A power outputs for phones, per the manual. They are not a data interface. Do not mistake them for one.

POW-M60-PRO and POW-M60-MAX are electrically near-identical (both 160 Vdc PV, 2800 W @ 48 V, 60 A, 9-70 V battery range); they differ in DC load output (6 A vs 25 A rated) and LCD size. Neither gains a port from the other.

PowMr hybrid *inverters* (POW-HVM, POW-SunSmart, 4500 W/6500 W) genuinely do speak Modbus — see leodesigner/powmr_comm (RS232, 2400 baud, slave 5) and odya/esphome-powmr-hybrid-inverter.
